investigations.summary: CLI Generic: pmm-admin --version and summary --version tests expect the server's version (3.10.0-v3-29d0075b2) but the pmm3-rc client prints 3.10.0; the server image perconalab/pmm-server:3.10.0-rc reports a v3-<sha> dev-style version. From run logs only, no VM reproduction.

CodeceptJS @ssl-mysql: PMM-T1403/T1404/T1426/T1431 (maxQueryLength empty variant) timed out because the QAN Explain tab kept showing 'Error 1064 (42000): You have an error in your SQL', the only failure of 15; 14 others passed. From run logs only, no VM reproduction.

ha backup-restore: PMM-T2371 failed on 'min(up{job=kube-apiserver})' = 0 after the in-place restore on OpenShift with perconalab/pmm-server:3.10.0-rc; the same test passed on OpenShift in pmm3-ha-tests #137 (no restore) and in backup-restore #11 (3-dev-latest). The cluster was already deleted and no OpenShift reproduction was run.
